patients.label: 59-year-old woman with sigmoid colon carcinoma who developed ulcerative pancolitis after resection and capecitabine
attribution_limitations: The body diagnosis sentence is worded "was considered as"; it is recorded as confirmed because it is the authors' final diagnosis, stated without hedging in the case abstract and followed by induction and maintenance therapy. The discussion hedges the cause (resection, capecitabine, perioperative stress or underlying silent colitis).

The case sentence does not state the capecitabine setting. The discussion contrasts the case's "adjuvant chemotherapy regimen" with the literature but does not name capecitabine, so the setting stays unknown. The order of resection and capecitabine is not stated in the case text.
Hemoglobin, white blood cell and platelet values are placed in a parenthesis in the sentence about unresolved symptoms on the seventh day of treatment; no flags are stated.
The sentence reports the erythrocyte sedimentation rate beside "Other biochemical parameters were normal" but does not classify the ESR value itself.
